tests.name: Pure merge leaves its complete input objects unchanged
New THB price gets precise retailer/date/evidence without manufacturer promotion
Retailer evidence does not alter identities, category, descriptions, photos, colors or reviews
Incoming null, blank and zero prices cannot erase an existing source-backed price
An existing primary price/source wins even over a newer different valid quote
Zero, negative and nonnumeric new prices remain unknown, never become THB0
Unaccepted, non-THB, missing quote and HTTP403 price evidence are refused
Wrong model, mismatch amount and mismatched observed Offer are refused
Search URLs and retailer category pages cannot be precise primary price evidence
Invalid source dates are refused; verifiedOn aliases remain stored correctly
Unknown evidence IDs never create a product
Incoming duplicate, missing and replaced IDs abort rather than silently changing inventory
A matching ID cannot rename a brand or model
Only accepted missing specifications fill; raw editorial strings are never technical evidence
Narrower SKU woods and fretboard values never replace broader existing options
Null, blank and invalid numeric specifications cannot erase or fabricate existing values
A sourced fretless zero is a valid fact; numeric zero remains invalid for price/scale/strings
Existing fretless zero is retained when another source proposes frets
Unaccepted, unsupported and HTTP403 specifications are refused
Retailer specification evidence stays explicitly retailer-sourced, without verified status
Evidence adapters honor explicit rejected fields and canonical keys
Reviewed datastore wins over a duplicate phase7 backing row
Phase7-only records update in place without reordering or introducing a reviewed override
Applying an already-merged result is idempotent, including sources and field arrays
CSV reader handles BOM, quoted commas, escaped quotes and CRLF
Actual archive covers exactly original200 IDs,10 brands×20, and all JSON/CSV representations agree
Actual import plan is exactly nine verified new prices plus nine missing fields on ten models
Actual null prices keep all18 old prices, FG820-12 quote and broader manufacturer fields
Actual Thunderbird category and full200 inventory/order/status stay unchanged
Actual complete import is idempotent with zero repeated data changes
